articles.summary: The Board of Directors of Sensient Technologies Corporation (NYSE: SXT) has declared a regular quarterly cash dividend on its common stock of $0.41 per share. The cash dividend will be paid on December 1, 2026, to shareholders of record on November 9, 2026. About Sensient Technologies Sensient Technologies Corporation is a leading global manufacturer and marketer of colors, flavors, and other specialty ingredients. Sensient uses advanced technologies and robust global supply chain capabilities to develop specialized solutions for food and beverages, as well as products that serve the pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, and personal care industries. Sensient’s customers range in size from small entrepreneurial businesses to major international manufacturers representing some of the world’s best-known brands. Sensient is headquartered in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. www.sensient.com Category: Dividends Source: Sensient Technologies Corporation Investor Relations (414) 347-3706 Source:

Investors may access the live webcast on the Company’s web site at investor.sensient.com . Alternatively, investors may join the conference call by contacting Chorus Call Inc. at (844) 492-3726 or (412) 317-1078. articles.summary: Sensient Technologies Corporation (NYSE: SXT), a leading provider of flavors and colors for the food, pharmaceutical, and personal care markets, today reported financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. Third Quarter Consolidated Results Reported revenue increased 10.6% to $455.8 million in the third quarter of 2026 versus last year’s third quarter results of $412.1 million. On a local currency basis (1) , revenue increased 10.2%. Reported operating income increased 25.5% to $72.4 million compared to $57.7 million recorded in last year’s third quarter. In the third quarter of 2025, the Company recorded $3.3 million of costs related to its Portfolio Optimization Plan versus no costs recorded in the third quarter of 2026 Local currency adjusted operating income (1) and local currency adjusted EBITDA (1) were up 18.6% and 15.4%, respectively, in the third quarter.
